headline: ILO urges evidence-based wage review, peaceful dialogue amid RMG unrest
summary: The UN labour agency urged that minimum wage adjustments reflect living costs, inflation, productivity and business sustainability. It called for peaceful dialogue amid unrest in the ready-made garment sector.
why: Ready-made garments are Bangladesh's largest export industry, and wage levels shape its cost competitiveness. Labour unrest can disrupt factory output and buyer deliveries.
